title: Add event subscriber for OpenPermissionSetPage
summary: A new event subscriber codeunit enables programmatic opening of the permission set details card based on client signals.
key_points: Adds event subscriber in System Application to handle permission set card opening
Allows client signals to trigger display of permission set details card
Updates permission set objects to support the new subscriber
Provides extensibility point for permission set workflows
quote: Add event subscriber that will open permission set details card page for provided values.
